description: Declarative runtime benchmark, latency, cost, reproducibility, sampling, and environment-capture workflow pack.

base_pack_promotion.reason: Runtime benchmarking is an optional measurement overlay; defaultspack remains the runtime and execution owner.
promotion_blockers: No executable benchmark runner is owned by this pack.
Latency and cost thresholds require maintainer-approved production-like evidence.
Sampling and environment capture must prove reproducibility before promotion.

conflict_notes: This pack declares owner boundaries and handoff policy instead of overriding runtime tools.
Model quality metrics remain in rumi_model_evals_pack.
Run event logging remains in rumi_observability_pack.
Release gate reporting remains in rumi_devops_release_pack.
